depends_on.name: fit_input_id
depends_on.documentation: The document this fit was computed FROM. Declared by NDI's template AND its schema; V_eta had dropped it. Left untyped -- the input class is not established and the vhlab_voltage2firingrate writer is in no repository we have.

depends_on.name: element_id
depends_on.documentation: The recording element, promoted to a subject with its id preserved by migrators_j.element (device-as-subject, D2).

fields.name: fit_equation
fields.documentation: The fitted equation. The migrator uses this as the observation's `method`. V_eta previously called this `fit_function`, a name no NDI template has ever carried.

fields.name: fit_parameters
fields.documentation: The fitted parameter values. NOT re-expressed by the migrator -- a fit's parameters fold to a method / settings document, a per-class decision that is still open.

fields.name: fit_parameter_names
fields.documentation: The names of the fitted parameters, positionally matching fit_parameters.

fields.name: fit_sse
fields.documentation: SUM OF SQUARED ERRORS. Unbounded, in the fitted variable's units squared, and LOWER IS BETTER -- it is NOT the r^2 the old `r_squared` field claimed, which is bounded 0..1 and higher-is-better. Substituting one for the other would have inverted every downstream comparison while looking like a rename.

fields.name: fit_sse_perpoint
fields.documentation: SSE normalised per point -- the figure that compares across fits of different lengths.

fields.name: fit_constraints
fields.documentation: The constraints the fit was run under ({fit_constraint_name, fit_constraint_value}).
